answer_1.quote: Names are generated by the LLM and randomly assigned to each agent. ... Furthermore, we prompt the LLM to generate ten job titles for each decile of the monthly wage distribution ... we input dialogues of this quarter into the LLM, prompting it to 'reflect' on the economic phenomena and to respond to how these phenomena might influence its subsequent decisions.
answer_1.outputs: Generated job titles, agent names, and reflection responses describing economic phenomena.
